periods.time: During Tokyo and Kyushu simultaneous emergencies
periods.location: Miyazaki refugee shelter and Ayatsuji dojo in Tokyo
periods.summary: Recognizing that Kyushu evacuation cannot finish before Tendo acts again, Moroboshi looks for an additional option. He asks Kanata for Ayase's contact and calls Ayase, who is preparing for Tokyo's emergency summons. Moroboshi tells her to send Kuraudo Kurashiki to Kyushu instead, arguing that Kuraudo is more useful against Daien than on the Tokyo front and that Moroboshi will take responsibility.
periods.cause: Moroboshi knows he can hurt Tendo but cannot approach through Tendo's saturation attacks; he needs someone with extraordinary reflexes to serve as the second arrow.
periods.process: Ayase protests that all eastern student knights are being summoned to defend Tokyo and angrily denies being Kuraudo's woman. Moroboshi insists, citing Itsuki's own principle of proper placement, and later arrives with Kuraudo before Toka's operation begins.
periods.outcome: Kuraudo reaches Kyushu and becomes the second arrow in the anti-Daien plan. His unauthorized relocation creates a later disciplinary issue but proves strategically decisive.
periods.significance: Adds the combat piece needed for Moroboshi's Tiger Bite enchant strategy and showcases Moroboshi's independent commander judgment.
